name: oxylabs-web-api
description: Live web search and page reading through the Oxylabs Web API: real SERP results, country-accurate, and pages that a plain fetch cannot retrieve. Runs on the Oxylabs-hosted MCP server with your Web API key.

interface.shortDescription: Live web search and page reading
interface.longDescription: Search the live web and read any page through the Oxylabs Web API: real SERP results from the target country, JS-heavy and bot-protected pages included, Markdown rendered server-side. Includes skills for web research with citations and for migrating from other search APIs. Needs an Oxylabs Web API key in the OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY environment variable.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for the latest news on a topic
Read this URL and summarize it
Find companies that compete with a given company
